records.title: Static assignment starts and stops with exact identity and a complete lease
records.blocker: The product controller does not yet connect immutable identity, whole-bundle lease, selected VFIO backend, fd-only QEMU attach and verified clean release.

records.title: Static start fails closed when a reused BDF has a different identity
records.blocker: The persisted assignment and launch admission do not yet compare current fingerprint, topology and qualification dependencies before side effects.

records.title: Busy dependency changes availability without changing capability
records.blocker: The product publisher and lease store lack an end-to-end A/B test separating owner-independent capability from current bundle availability.

records.title: Guest reboot preserves function on a qualified physical device
records.blocker: Final guest-reboot continuity and post-reboot device function require a qualified physical device and workload; emulated or nested devices are not sufficient.

records.title: Forced VM power-off completes verified teardown before reuse
records.blocker: Forced-off notification, independent DMA/IRQ cleanup receipt, release reset and product quarantine decisions are not integrated.

records.title: Ten physical-device reuse cycles leave no stale DMA, interrupt or state
records.blocker: The final repeated-reuse gate requires a qualified physical device, independent DMA/IRQ observation and a real workload across ten complete cycles.

records.title: Snapshot and suspend requests are denied without changing assignment state
records.blocker: Snapshot and suspend are outside the DirectPath boundary, but the product API, scheduler and launcher negative gate does not yet exist; the case cannot be marked FEATURE_DISABLED.

records.title: Fault Tolerance requests are denied for DirectPath VMs
records.blocker: Fault Tolerance is outside scope, but no executable product gate yet proves every API, scheduler and launch path rejects it without changing the VM or lease.

records.title: Changed reset affected set invalidates the attach plan before reset
records.blocker: The product reset executor lacks an execution-time affected-set re-query and fault injection proving no reset or QEMU start occurs after drift.

records.title: Failed post-reset state probe quarantines the whole affected set
records.blocker: No production reset probe and quarantine transaction proves that a failed state check prevents every affected member from returning to FREE.

records.title: Qman fixed-hotplug API remains disabled and immutable
records.blocker: Runtime PCI hotplug is outside scope, but the API negative gate and unchanged-definition proof are not implemented; policy text alone is not FEATURE_DISABLED evidence.

records.title: Running Dynamic VM cannot replace its selected backing
records.blocker: The Dynamic controller does not yet reject runtime backing replacement while proving assignedId, lease, guest function and generation remain unchanged.

records.title: Concurrent hotplug bypass attempts cannot mutate ownership or guest topology
records.blocker: The product-wide concurrent API, scheduler, launcher and QMP bypass matrix does not exist, so no negative gate proves all generations and DMA/IRQ owners remain unchanged.
